local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RS = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local pg = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local flying = false
local flySpeed = 50
local minSpeed, maxSpeed = 10, 200
local bv, bg
local character, humanoid, root

local function getChar()
	character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end
task.spawn(getChar)

local old = pg:FindFirstChild("Fly gui mobile")
if old then old:Destroy() end

local sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
sg.Name = "Fly gui mobile"
sg.ResetOnSpawn = false
sg.IgnoreGuiInset = true
sg.DisplayOrder = 999999
sg.Enabled = true
sg.Parent = pg

local main = Instance.new("Frame")
main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(280, 180)
main.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
	math.floor(workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X / 2 - 140),
	math.floor(workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y * 0.55)
)
main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 35)
main.BorderSizePixel = 0

main.Parent = sg
Instance.new("UICorner", main).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

title.BorderSizePixel = 0
title.Text = "Fly GUI Mobile"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
title.TextSize = 18
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.Parent = main
Instance.new("UICorner", title).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

do
	local dragging = false
	local offset = Vector2.zero
	title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			local abs = main.AbsolutePosition
			offset = Vector2.new(input.Position.X - abs.X, input.Position.Y - abs.Y)
		end
	end)
	UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if not dragging then return end
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			main.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(input.Position.X - offset.X, input.Position.Y - offset.Y)

local function stopFly()
	flying = false
	if bv then bv:Destroy() bv = nil end
	if bg then bg:Destroy() bg = nil end
	if humanoid then humanoid.PlatformStand = false end
	btn.Text = "ATIVAR FLY"
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 180, 80)
end

local function startFly()
	if not root or not root.Parent then getChar() end
	if not root then return end
	flying = true
	bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
	bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
	bv.Parent = root
	bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
	bg.P = 1e4
	bg.Parent = root
	humanoid.PlatformStand = true
	btn.Text = "DESATIVAR FLY"
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 60)
end

btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if flying then stopFly() else startFly() end
end)

RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not flying or not bv or not bg or not root or not root.Parent then return end

	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local look = cam.CFrame.LookVector
	local right = cam.CFrame.RightVector
	local move = Vector3.zero

	-- teclado: W = onde olha
	if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then move += look end
	if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then move -= look end
	if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then move -= right end
	if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then move += right end

	-- joystick: direção certa (não invertida)
	if humanoid then
		local md = humanoid.MoveDirection
		if md.Magnitude > 0.05 then
			local flatLook = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
			local flatRight = Vector3.new(right.X, 0, right.Z)
			if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.01 then flatLook = flatLook.Unit end
			if flatRight.Magnitude > 0.01 then flatRight = flatRight.Unit end

			local frente = md:Dot(flatLook)
			local lado = md:Dot(flatRight)

			-- frente do joystick = direção da câmera (sobe se olhar pra cima)
			move += look * frente + right * lado
		end
	end

	bv.Velocity = move.Magnitude > 0 and move.Unit * flySpeed or Vector3.zero
	bg.CFrame = cam.CFrame
end)

local sliding = false
local function setSpeed(rel)
	rel = math.clamp(rel, 0, 1)
	flySpeed = math.floor(minSpeed + (maxSpeed - minSpeed) * rel)
	label.Text = "Velocidade: " .. flySpeed
	fill.Size = UDim2.new(rel, 0, 1, 0)
	thumb.Position = UDim2.new(rel, -11, 0.5, -11)
end

local function fromInput(pos)
	local x = track.AbsolutePosition.X
	local w = track.AbsoluteSize.X
	if w > 0 then setSpeed((pos.X - x) / w) end
end

track.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
	if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		sliding = true
		fromInput(i.Position)
	end
end)
thumb.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
	if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		sliding = true
	end
end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
	if sliding and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		fromInput(i.Position)
	end
end)
UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
	if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		sliding = false
	end
end)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	task.wait(0.3)
	getChar()
	if flying then stopFly() end
end)

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local Weapons = Shared:WaitForChild("Weapons")
local RecoilConfigModule = Weapons:WaitForChild("RecoilConfig")
local RecoilConfig = require(RecoilConfigModule)
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local function removeRecoilAndSpread(configTable)
	if not configTable then return end
	if configTable.Punch then
		configTable.Punch.VelocityDegPerSec = 0
		configTable.Punch.MagnitudeVariance = 0
		configTable.Punch.AngleVarianceDeg = 0
		configTable.Punch.AimPunchScale = 0
		configTable.Punch.ViewRecoilTracking = 0
		configTable.Punch.ViewPunchExtraFrac = 0
		configTable.Punch.ViewPunchDecay = 9999
	end
	if configTable.Inaccuracy then
		configTable.Inaccuracy.SpreadDeg = 0
		configTable.Inaccuracy.StandDeg = 0
		configTable.Inaccuracy.CrouchDeg = 0
		configTable.Inaccuracy.FireDeg = 0
		configTable.Inaccuracy.MoveDeg = 0
		configTable.Inaccuracy.JumpDeg = 0
		configTable.Inaccuracy.JumpInitialDeg = 0
		configTable.Inaccuracy.JumpApexDeg = 0
		configTable.Inaccuracy.MaxInaccuracyDeg = 0
		if configTable.Inaccuracy.Movement then
			configTable.Inaccuracy.Movement.SlideAddDeg = 0
		end
	end
end

removeRecoilAndSpread(RecoilConfig)

if RecoilConfig.Configs then
	for weaponName, configList in pairs(RecoilConfig.Configs) do
		if configList.Primary then removeRecoilAndSpread(configList.Primary) end
		if configList.Secondary then removeRecoilAndSpread(configList.Secondary) end
		removeRecoilAndSpread(configList)
	end
end

local originalGet = RecoilConfig.Get
RecoilConfig.Get = function(self, weaponName, fireMode)
	local currentConfig = originalGet(self, weaponName, fireMode)
	removeRecoilAndSpread(currentConfig)
	return currentConfig
end

LocalPlayer:SetAttribute("StrafeStyleId", "Autohop")
LocalPlayer:SetAttribute("AutoJump", true)

task.spawn(function()
	local SharedFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared", 10)
	if SharedFolder then
		local MovementV2 = SharedFolder:WaitForChild("MovementV2", 10)
		if MovementV2 then
			local StrafeStyleConfig = MovementV2:FindFirstChild("StrafeStyleConfig")
			if StrafeStyleConfig then
				local success, config = pcall(require, StrafeStyleConfig)
				if success and type(config) == "table" then
					for _, style in pairs(config) do
						if type(style) == "table" then
							style.AutoJump = true
							style.AutoBhop = true
						end
					end
				end
			end
			local MovementConfig = MovementV2:FindFirstChild("MovementConfig")
			if MovementConfig then
				local success, moveConfig = pcall(require, MovementConfig)
				if success and type(moveConfig) == "table" then
					moveConfig.AutoJump = true
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		if char then
			local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum and hum:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
				hum.Jump = true
			end
		end
	end
end)

	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(setupCollision)

local function getRakeModelPosition(model)
    local ok, pos = pcall(function()
        return model:GetPivot().Position
    end)
    if ok and pos then return pos end

    local primary = model.PrimaryPart
    if primary then return primary.Position end

    local anyPart = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)

    return nil

    for model, data in pairs(rakeEspCache) do

        if data.billboard then pcall(function() data.billboard:Destroy() end) end
        rakeEspCache[model] = nil
    end
    rakeEspCache = {}

    if rakeConnection then return end
    rakeAccumulator = 0
    rakeConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if not State.ShowRake then return end
        rakeAccumulator = rakeAccumulator + dt
        if rakeAccumulator >= RAKE_UPDATE_RATE then
            rakeAccumulator = 0
            scanForRake()

            local char = player.Character
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                local myPos = root.Position
                for model, data in pairs(rakeEspCache) do
                    if data.distLabel and data.distLabel.Parent then
                        local pos = getRakeModelPosition(model)
                        if pos then
                            local dist = (pos - myPos).Magnitude
                            data.distLabel.Text = string.format("%d studs", math.floor(dist + 0.5))
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

        rakeConnection = nil
    end

    for _, conn in ipairs(SKELETON_CONNECTIONS) do
        local part1 = plr.Character:FindFirstChild(conn[1])
        local part2 = plr.Character:FindFirstChild(conn[2])
        if part1 and part2 then
            local pos1, on1 = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part1.Position)

    flyConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

        if not RootPart or not RootPart.Parent then return end
        if not Humanoid or Humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
        
        local moveDir = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
            moveDir = moveDir + Camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
            moveDir = moveDir - Camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
            moveDir = moveDir - Camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
            moveDir = moveDir + Camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
            moveDir = moveDir + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)

        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then

        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
            moveDir = moveDir * 2
        end
        if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
            moveDir = moveDir.Unit
        end
        
        bodyVelocity.Velocity = moveDir * FlySpeed
        bodyGyro.CFrame = Camera.CFrame
        
        pcall(function()
            if Humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics then
                Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
            end
        end)
    end)
end

    if flyConn then flyConn:Disconnect() flyConn = nil end
    if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity:Destroy() bodyVelocity = nil end
    if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy() bodyGyro = nil end
    restoreStates()

scripts.features:
PulseCore Place Saver

PulseCore Place Saver is a lightweight Roblox utility script for saving the current place using the executor's `saveinstance` functionality.

Before saving, PulseCore displays a confirmation window explaining that the game may temporarily freeze while the place is being processed. The user can choose whether to continue or cancel the operation.

Features

Place Saver

Save the current Roblox place with `saveinstance`.

* Full place saving
* Script decompilation when supported
* Automatically generated filenames
* Uses the current Place ID and timestamp in the filename
* Manual saving with `RightShift`

Startup Confirmation

A PulseCore-styled confirmation window appears when the script starts.

It warns that the game may temporarily freeze during the save process.

`Continue` — Starts the place save.

`Cancel` — Cancels the operation and completely stops the script.

Roblox Notifications

Uses Roblox's built-in notification system instead of a custom notification GUI.

Notifications are shown for:

* Script loaded
* Save started
* Save completed
* Save failed
* Script cancelled
* Missing `saveinstance

Error Handling

The save operation is protected with error handling so failures can be reported through Roblox notifications without silently stopping the script.

Controls

`RightShift` — Save the current place again.

Requirements

The script requires an executor with a working `saveinstance` function.

Available `saveinstance` features and parameters may vary depending on the executor.
